head.text: Software reset (write bit 1 of 0x30000202) - the reset pulse cancels itself

foot.text: RESET_CONTROL_OUT forces nSYS_RESET low asynchronously in BUSCTRL, but INTCTRL clears RESET_CONTROL_OUT with that same nSYS_RESET, so reset ends at the next falling CPU_CLK edge. The pulse is about one clock long. The MC68030 needs RESET for at least 10 clocks to reset its logic (520 recommended), and ATA devices need 25 us.
